services.name: Glo Karting
services.desc: K1 Speed Karting Academy is for both beginners and advanced racers and is a great way to learn more about karting and motorsport. If you would like to get involved with the sport of karting or are interested in improving your lap times with more advanced racing techniques, we would be happy to help. Karting is our passion at K1 Speed, and we are intimately familiar with the workings of our 20hp electric karts and the ins-and-outs of proper racing technique. If you are looking for an affordable race class, then our go kart racing class is for you! Please feel free to contact K1 Speed today for more information or to schedule a reservation for one of our upcoming sessions. The Karting Academy

blurb: K1 Speed offers world-class indoor karting experiences with special events, group events, and private parties. Guests can race on indoor tracks and participate in championships. Membership includes a rewards program to collect races.
